title: Add source-check section to producer brief (retry of vbq4)
summary: Retry of job 20261114-045722-vbq4 (dispatched, never verified, no findings): same reading. Root cause: the producer brief never tells the producer to check content summarizing named sources against every source and every sense of a term. Fix it in the brief, with a test, and add no refusal rule.

defaults_applied.how: Behavior criteria run the brief tests and check the section is present and that removing it fails the test.
fmt, clippy and cargo test criterion.
The fix is a brief section with a test, not a prose-only rule.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (producer_brief calls producer_brief_with_evidence at ~line 682, which appends sections via helpers such as banned_words_section, mirror_check_section, existing_tests_section) and listed crates/athena-context/src/briefs/ (boundary.rs, reader.rs, plan.rs, planner.rs). The new section follows the same helper pattern, so it appears for fresh and retry jobs alike. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord/round-trip tests are not touched. The property is measured directly by asserting on the rendered brief text.

Existing code: crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, crates/athena-context/src/briefs/boundary.rs; the new section extends them and the test reuses the existing producer-brief test helpers in briefs.rs.

Job 20261114-045722-vbq4 recorded no candidate and no findings, so there is no earlier work to keep; the fresh attempt uses its accepted reading and deliverables unchanged. Audience: the producer agents who read the brief, and the verifier checking the diff.

Dropped candidates of 20261017-173508-0wtc, 20261025-214509-y179 and 20261031-172040-kq9v stay dropped (docs/ontology.toml, crates/athena-cli/tests/ontology.rs, secrets.rs, checks.rs, ci.yml, xtask files).
docs/decision-links.toml changes only if the new entry amends an earlier decision or touches a [[governs]] path, so it is a low-probability deliverable.
The new brief text is not a prompt file under prompts/, so the token budgets are unaffected.

acceptance_criteria.text: New docs/decisions.md entry, appended after the last existing line (no existing entry edited), names the root cause for job 20261114-045722-vbq4's class: the producer stage lacked an instruction to check content summarizing named sources against those sources, for every sense of a term. It has a Provenance bullet, and CHANGELOG.md records the job.

crates/athena-context/src/briefs/boundary.rs (or briefs.rs) holds a new section function/constant telling the producer to search each governing source for every term, claim or list it writes, list every sense found, compare any hand-kept list with the file that defines it, and state what it did not check; producer_brief_with_evidence in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs includes it (visible in git diff).

Run `cargo test -p athena-context`. The new brief test passes: producer_brief output contains the new section for a fresh job and for a retry; the test fails when the section call is removed from producer_brief_with_evidence.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`. Existing tests that read the producer brief still pass.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, then `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, then `cargo test`, each as its own command. All pass; a passing Athena-recorded check on the final tree counts.
The git diff adds no refusal or gating rule: no change to check, gate, admission or landing code, none to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows, and no prompt .md file under crates/*/prompts/.

out_of_scope: Any refusal rule or gate that rejects work for a contradicted term

Re-applying the dropped candidates of 20261017-173508-0wtc, 20261025-214509-y179 and 20261031-172040-kq9v: docs/ontology.toml, crates/athena-cli/tests/ontology.rs, secrets.rs, checks.rs, ci.yml, xtask/src/main.rs, xtask/tests/policy.rs
Changing athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows or tool pins
Changing the verifier or reader prompt files, which are at their token limits
Editing or removing existing docs/decisions.md entries or anything under records/
hard_reason: It changes the run pipeline's producer brief, which every job's producer reads.
